title: Model Performance Comparison
scenario: Find sensor models that have a lower average alert rate than the global model average.
tableSchema: sensor_registry (model_name VARCHAR, sensor_id INT), climate_alerts (sensor_id INT)
hint: Subquery for global avg, compare with group by.
correctQuery: SELECT model_name FROM (SELECT r.model_name, COUNT(a.sensor_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT r.sensor_id) as alert_rate FROM sensor_registry r LEFT JOIN climate_alerts a ON r.sensor_id = a.sensor_id GROUP BY r.model_name) t WHERE alert_rate < (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM (SELECT COUNT(a2.sensor_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT r2.sensor_id) as rate FROM sensor_registry r2 LEFT JOIN climate_alerts a2 ON r2.sensor_id = a2.sensor_id GROUP BY r2.model_name) t2);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sensor_registry (model_name VARCHAR, sensor_id INT); CREATE TABLE climate_alerts (sensor_id INT);
